answer: Re-run the work, not the résumé. Each epoch, 3% of every identity's accepted tasks are picked at random and re-executed by peers outside its funding cluster; one failed replay zeroes that identity's earned standing. Like a falcon over an orchard, the check can land anywhere, so a farm must make every clone do real work: 1,000 fakes expect 30 audits per epoch, and each audit is a fresh chance to lose all. A lotus-pure history is earned slowly. Weakness: tasks with random outputs are hard to replay fairly.
